Privacy Policy

21 October 2026

Actual site interfaces

This site has no account, booking, ticket sales, contact form or email address for sending data. External source links lead to third-party services.

Technical data

The hosting provider may process IP addresses, browsers and page requests to deliver and protect the service. Analytics choices are stored in the browser, not a customer profile on this site.

Hosting performance measurement

Cloudflare Web Analytics may be added by the hosting provider to measure page views and loading performance using a browser beacon. This operates separately from Google Analytics: the Google Analytics setting below does not control this hosting measurement. Script inclusion alone does not mean a measurement request succeeds. See Cloudflare’s Web Analytics documentation.

Google Maps

Embedded maps on both homepages load when the map section is approached and make requests to Google. Technical data may reach the provider separately from the Google Analytics choice. Read Google’s privacy policy.

Analytics choices

Google Analytics loads only after an explicit analytics choice. It may use cookies and usage data and is not described as anonymous. A tab-session refusal overrides old permission if a permanent write fails. If session storage cannot be read, Google Analytics stays off. Settings messages explain storage limitations.

Browser controls

Reject or withdraw Google Analytics in Cookie Settings, or clear site data and cookies in your browser. Language links do not store language preferences. The site code does not enable marketing tracking.
